description: This file defines interface function prototypes for the ssp_messagebus component, including functions for engaging the message bus, initialization, finalization, resource freeing, and a synchronization check function, along with include guards and licensing information.
external_methods: BOOLEAN waitConditionReady(void*, const char*, char*, char*)

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus component with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with the provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up resources for the message bus interface with the provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status or health of the message bus with the provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus interface based on priority and user data.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits until a specific condition or state is ready on the message bus, involving source and destination components and paths.

calls: BOOLEAN waitConditionReady(void*, const char*, char*, char*)
